label: Anomaly File
line: State the rule, show the one case that breaks it, say why that should be impossible, then investigate: how it worked, the new evidence, the answer with numbers, and one detail that still does not fit.
best_for: evidence that looked wrong: every gauge normal during a failure, a record that should not exist
a historical or scientific puzzle with a real anomaly
also_for: an outage or a bug whose strangest part is what the evidence showed
avoid_for: a case whose answer is common knowledge

beats.name: The rule
beats.job: What normally happens, and why that makes sense.

beats.name: Why impossible
beats.job: One short line of stakes: things like this do not just happen.

beats.name: New evidence
beats.job: Dated: when it was found, and what was unexpected.

beats.name: Answer
beats.job: The hypothesis as a question, then yes, with the mechanism and two numbers.

beats.name: Reopen
beats.job: One piece of evidence still does not fit.

beats.name: Close
beats.job: The open question, stated plainly, or the current theory in one sentence.

hooks.shape: When [this kind of thing] happens, [the pattern] almost always follows. In [case], [the opposite picture].
What happened to [the object]? And what happened to [the people]?
In [year], [a person, by role] opened [the thing] and found [what should not have been there].

holds: Stacked questions: the first answer lands at about three fifths and a new question opens before the viewer can leave. The dated new evidence re-opens the middle; an answer with numbers that seems to close the case comes before the reopen.
ending: An open question, stated plainly, or the current theory in one sentence. It must be a real open question.
pitfalls: Inventing the detail that does not fit: the reopen must be true
Skipping the rule, so the break means nothing
template: When [this kind of thing] happens, [the normal finding]. [Why that makes sense]. But in [case], [the opposite, one picture]. [Things like this] do not just [do that]. [How it worked, two numbers]. Then in [year], [someone, by role] found [new fact]. Was it [hypothesis]? Yes: [mechanism, numbers]. But one detail still does not fit: [second anomaly]. [The open question].
